ability.name: Spirit Bomb
ability.text: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within @AbilityCenterHexRange@ hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a @HexRadius@ hex radius, reduced by @HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip@ per hex away from the epicenter.

ability.name: Kunai Strike
ability.text: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</Bright> Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. If the target is <keyword>Burning</keyword>, deal an additional @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: If the Ability kills, cast it again.</dim>

ability.name: Triumphant Roar
ability.text: Roar, restoring @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%. Then slam the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.text: Rain @NumMoonshards@ moonshards split among the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage each.\n\nIf the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies.

ability.name: Moonlight's Onslaught
ability.text: Equip Severum and swipe the target @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAS% times over @Duration@ seconds, each dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. \n\nAfter the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

ability.name: Spirit Rift
ability.text:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageFalloffPerEnemy@ per enemy hit (minimum @MinDamagePercent@). If no enemies are hit refund @ManaRefund@ of mana spent.

The arrow leaves a trail for @RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% + @MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@ max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and @ChillPercent@% <Keyword>Slows</Keyword> them.

<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</Rules>

ability.name: Arise!
ability.text: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed and summon @SoldiersToSpawn@ soldiers for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per attack.

ability.name: Headshot
ability.text: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage.

ability.name: Defensive Sweep
ability.text: Slice the target for @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and gain @AbilityShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Noxious Blast
ability.text: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Poisons stack.

ability.name: Pale Barrier
ability.text: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and send out @NumOrbs@ moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.

ability.name: Heat Without Equal
ability.text:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Attacks deal @AttackAoERatio@ damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds, gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp, and Ignite them for @IgniteDuration@ seconds.  Ignited enemies take @IgniteMaxHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.

<Bright>Flame Breath:</Bright>  Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinimumDamageThreshold@.) Ignite those enemies for @IgniteDuration@ seconds.

Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below @TraitExecuteThreshold@ Health executes them.

ability.name: Spider Queen
ability.text: Transform into a spider and gain @SpiderHealthBuff@ max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage and heal for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%. Subsequent casts grant @DecayingAS@ decaying Attack Speed for @ASBuffDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Forest's Flurry
ability.text: Blink away from the current target, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them, and gain @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. \n\nEvery 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Forest's Flurry and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).

ability.name: Rage Gene
ability.text:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Gain @RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and @RagePerAttack@ Rage per attack. 

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within @TransformSearchRadius@ hexes. Then, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies within @TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, and Stun them for @StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @HealthCalc1@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw.

<Bright>Grab n' Throw:</Bright> Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them and @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

ability.name: Spirit of Dread
ability.text: Gain @Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Triggerseed
ability.text: <bright>Passive:</bright> Shields from this Ability can critically strike with <Keyword>Precision</Keyword>. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Grant @NumAlliesToShield@ allies @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleDA% Shield and @DamageAmpAmount@ Damage Amp for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting @CastThreshold@ times, also grant @AttackSpeed@ stacking Attack Speed to targets.

ability.name: Solar Judgement
ability.text:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 

<Bright>1st Ascension:</Bright> Attacks deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage.
<Bright>2nd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks @ShredLevel@% <Keyword>Shred</Keyword> enemies hit for @ShredDuration@ seconds. 
<Bright>3rd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks fire waves, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all other units hit.
<Bright>4th Ascension:</Bright> Gain infinite range. Every @NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@rd wave is much larger.

<Rules>Shred: Reduce Magic Resist</Rules>

Then, gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each. \n\nAfter rushing, unleash a @FirestormHexRadius@ Hex firestorm that deals a total of @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies hit over @FirestormDuration@ seconds.

ability.text:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> On death, split into two Kruglettes with @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Gain @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% max Health, then roll into the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth% damage.

Slate Buff: On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for @TraitShieldHealth@ max Health.

ability.name: Final Spark
ability.text: <bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% mana. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit.

ability.name: Final Spark
ability.text:
<bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% mana. 

<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit (minimum @MinimumFalloffDamageRatio@).

<bright>Blackthorn Bonus:</bright> Stuns targets hit for @BlackthornStunDuration@ second.

ability.name: Final Spark
ability.text:
<bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% mana. 

<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit (minimum @MinimumFalloffDamageRatio@).

<bright>Blossom Bonus:</bright> The first target hit is dealt @BlossomBonusDamageRatio@ bonus damage.

ability.name: Rending Claws
ability.text: Leap to the lowest Health enemy within @LeapHexRadius@ Hexes and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. The next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks gain @EmpowerAspd@ Attack Speed and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% bonus physical damage.\n\nGrey Buff: Gain Precision and @TraitBaseCrit@ Critical Strike Chance, increased up to @TraitBonusCrit@ based on missing Health.

ability.name: Javelin Toss
ability.text: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</Bright> Gain @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.</dim>

ability.name: Can You Dig It?
ability.text:
<bright>Passive:</bright> Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to all adjacent enemies.

<bright>Active:</bright> Burrow underground, gaining @BurrowDurability@ Durability for @BurrowDuration@ seconds and healing @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% over the duration. 

Green Buff: When allies fall below @TraitHealthThreshold@ Health, they restore @TraitPercentHeal@ max Health.

ability.name: Azure Shockwave
ability.text:
Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, and are <keyword>Mana Reaved</keyword> for @ManaReaveFlat@.

Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain @TraitAlliesManaRegen@ Mana Regen.

<rules>Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.</rules>

ability.name: Emerald Radiance
ability.text: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below @PassivePercentHealthThreshold@ Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Shield to allies within @PassiveHexRadius@ Hexes for @PassiveShieldDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Taric and his paired ally deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage on their next @NumAttacks@ attacks.

ability.name: Furious Fists
ability.text: <bright>Passive:</bright> On attack, restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Unleash a primal roar, restoring @HealthCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Then gain @SpellAS@ Attack Speed, @SpellDurability@ Durability, and is unstoppable for @SpellDuration@ seconds.
